brief:
Palestinian football officially resumed this week following a three-year halt tied to the Gaza conflict, according to Al-Monitor. Sports commentator Khalil Jadallah, who spent the past three years mourning athletes killed during the war, returned to the stadium for the resumption of professional matches. His return proved bittersweet—a moment shadowed by the memory of those lost.

The restart of Palestinian professional sports marks a tentative return to normalcy for the occupied territory, though grief remained present at the pitch. Players and fans alike confronted the weight of the conflict's toll on the athletic community, even as competitions resumed and stadiums reopened to crowds seeking a return to familiar routines.
